Low Height Drawer Series – Cook Above. Chill Below.

Commercial kitchens are designed for speed, precision and consistency. Yet one common challenge often goes unnoticed: the distance between the cooktop and refrigerated ingredients.

During busy service hours, chefs repeatedly move between their cooking station and the refrigerator to retrieve ingredients. While each trip takes only a few seconds, the cumulative impact can slow operations, interrupt workflow and reduce overall efficiency.

Modern kitchen design is addressing this challenge by bringing refrigeration directly beneath the cooktop.

Bringing Refrigeration Directly Beneath the Cooktop

Integrated refrigeration creates a dedicated cooking station where chefs can access chilled ingredients without leaving the cooktop. Instead of walking across the kitchen, ingredients remain stored directly below the cooking equipment, improving accessibility and reducing unnecessary movement.

This approach offers several practical advantages:

  • Faster ingredient access
  • Improved workflow during service
  • Better use of valuable kitchen space
  • More organized refrigerated storage
  • Enhanced kitchen productivity

A smarter workstation keeps ingredients within reach, allowing chefs to focus on cooking rather than walking.

Making Better Use of Every Square Foot

As commercial kitchens become more compact, every inch of available space matters. Integrating refrigeration beneath the cooktop transforms unused undercounter space into productive refrigerated storage without increasing the kitchen footprint.

This makes it an ideal solution for hotels, restaurants, cafés, cloud kitchens, QSRs, bakeries and institutional kitchens looking to optimize both space and workflow.

Built Around the Chef’s Workflow

To support this evolving approach to kitchen design, Western Refrigeration developed the Low Height Drawer Series.

Engineered with a reduced cabinet height, the series is designed to accommodate commercial cooktops above while providing refrigerated storage below. Available in 2, 4 and 6 drawer configurations, the range combines SS304 stainless steel construction, Swiss-engineered drawer sliders, flexible installation options and a built-in fixed tray system to keep ingredients organised and easily accessible throughout service.

By placing refrigeration exactly where it’s needed, the Low Height Drawer Series helps create a more efficient, organised and productive cooking station for today’s professional kitchens.
